metadata.description: RAN4 Phase-4 CQ — CR 변경 근거/Cross-Spec/CR Pack 검증

questions.question: 특정 CR의 변경 이유(reasonForChange)는?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:CR {tdocNumber: 'R4-2107689'}) RETURN c.reasonForChange AS reasonForChange LIMIT 1

questions.question: 특정 CR의 변경 요약(summaryOfChange)은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:CR {tdocNumber: 'R4-2107689'}) RETURN c.summaryOfChange AS summaryOfChange LIMIT 1

questions.question: 특정 CR의 미승인 영향(consequencesIfNotApproved)은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:CR {tdocNumber: 'R4-2107689'}) RETURN c.consequencesIfNotApproved AS consequences LIMIT 1

questions.question: 특정 CR이 영향주는 다른 Spec 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:CR)-[r:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(s:Spec) WHERE c.tdocNumber = 'R4-2207489' RETURN c.tdocNumber, type(r) AS relType, s.specNumber ORDER BY s.specNumber

questions.question: 특정 Spec을 수정하는 CR 중 다른 Spec에도 영향주는 CR은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(s:Spec {specNumber: '38.133'}) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (c)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->() } RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber ORDER BY c.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: 특정 Spec을 영향 받는 Spec으로 참조하는 CR 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (s:Spec {specNumber: '38.533'})<-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]-(c:CR) RETURN c.tdocNumber, c.summaryOfChange ORDER BY c.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: Cross-Spec 영향이 가장 많은 CR Top 10은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:CR)-[r:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->() WITH c, count(r) AS cnt ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 10 RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, cnt

questions.question: 특정 CR Pack에 포함된 CR 목록과 변경 요약은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (pack:CRPack {crPackId: 'RP-233366'})-[:HAS_CR]->(c:CR) RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, c.summaryOfChange AS summary ORDER BY c.tdocNumber LIMIT 10

questions.question: 특정 Work Item 관련 CR이 속한 Pack 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:CR)-[:RELATED_TO]->(w:WorkItem) WHERE w.workItemCode CONTAINS 'NR_newRAT' WITH c MATCH (c)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(pack:CRPack) RETURN DISTINCT pack.crPackId AS crPackId, pack.tsgMeeting AS tsgMeeting ORDER BY toInteger(split(pack.tsgMeeting, '#')[1]) DESC, crPackId ASC LIMIT 10
questions.expected: Pack list for NR_newRAT work items

questions.question: 특정 TSG 회의에 제출된 CR Pack 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (pack:CRPack {tsgMeeting: 'RAN#102'}) RETURN pack.crPackId AS crPackId ORDER BY pack.crPackId LIMIT 10

questions.question: 특정 Section을 수정하는 CR의 변경 이유 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (sec:Section {sectionNumber: '7.3A.5'})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber: '38.101-1'}) MATCH (sec)<-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]-(c:CR) RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, c.reasonForChange AS reason ORDER BY toInteger(replace(sp.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC, c.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10

questions.question: 특정 Resolution이 승인한 CR의 변경 이유와 요약은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:HAS_DISPOSITION]->(:DecisionDisposition {dispositionCode: 'agreed', evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(c:CR) WHERE c.reasonForChange IS NOT NULL WITH c LIMIT 5 RETURN c.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, c.reasonForChange AS reason, c.summaryOfChange AS summary
questions.approval_contract: Target-level dispositionCode=agreed + evidenceStatus=source_verified, bound to the exact Resolution and source span; REFERENCES and global document status do not assert approval.

questions.question: 특정 Work Item 관련 CR이 수정하는 Section 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:CR)-[:RELATED_TO]->(w:WorkItem) WHERE w.workItemCode CONTAINS 'NR_newRAT' WITH c MATCH (c)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(sec:Section) RETURN DISTINCT sec.sectionId AS sectionId ORDER BY sec.sectionId LIMIT 10

questions.question: 특정 회사의 CR이 영향주는 다른 Spec 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (c:CR)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(comp:Company) WHERE comp.companyName CONTAINS 'Samsung' WITH c MATCH (c)-[:AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC|AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC|AFFECTS_OM_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT s.specNumber AS spec ORDER BY spec LIMIT 10

questions.question: 특정 회의에서 승인된 CR의 변경 요약 목록은?
questions.cypher: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {meetingNumber: 'RAN4#109'}) WITH a MATCH (a)-[:HAS_DISPOSITION]->(:DecisionDisposition {dispositionCode: 'agreed', evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(t:Tdoc) WHERE t.summaryOfChange IS NOT NULL RETURN DISTINCT t.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber, t.summaryOfChange AS summary ORDER BY tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10
questions.approval_contract: Target-level dispositionCode=agreed + evidenceStatus=source_verified, bound to the exact Resolution and source span; REFERENCES and global document status do not assert approval.
